notes: Paper searches for decaying DM X-ray lines in eROSITA eFEDS data (mass range 1.8-18 keV). Reports a 95% upper limit on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (figure 7), using Caγγ≈0.75 (DFSZ). Primary model-independent result is a DM decay rate limit (~1e-27 s^-1, figure 4); ALP coupling limit is derived from it. NFW profile with rho_sun=0.4 GeV/cm^3. Data points are approximate readings from figure 7 (no numerical table given); the observed eFEDS limit is the new result while MW-center and all-sky curves are projections. Sterile-neutrino mixing-angle limits (figure 6) also presented but ALP g_agamma is the AxionPhoton-relevant result.
